About us

Built by riders, for bike lovers

Our story

Bike lovers deserve a shop that understands them. From our showroom, we bring you bikes of every kind: from your first bike or your child's, to a trail-ready mountain bike, a fast road bike or the classic Rambo, alongside helmets, lights and accessories.

We explain things plainly and stay with you after the sale. Whether you ride the desert trails, the city's streets or the open road, we want every ride to start with the right bike.

Vision

To be the first choice for bike lovers in Saudi Arabia, and to help build an active, confident community of cyclists.

Mission

To offer reliable bikes and kids' products at fair prices, with honest advice and service that keeps every rider on the road.

Values

Trust, quality, safety and a real passion for bikes, in everything we sell and every customer we serve.

What we offer

Products

  • Mountain bikes
  • Road & hybrid bikes
  • Sport, Cobra & Rambo bikes
  • Kids' bikes, tricycles & folding bikes
  • Helmets, lights & accessories
  • Kids' electric cars, scooters, strollers & play equipment

Services

  • Professional assembly
  • Maintenance & tune-ups
  • Bike fitting & sizing advice
  • Genuine spare parts & repairs
